Just a stone's throw from the world-renowned Tongariro River at the southern end of Lake Taupo, Judges Pool Motel offers comfortable, quiet place to stay. Stroll to the river pools to fish for big Rainbow and Brown Trout or venture to the nearby Tongariro National Park with its alpine walks and ski fields. Judges Pool Motel provides the perfect base for your activities or the ideal stopover with no traffic noise on your travels, with affordable family accommodation in our fully self-contained units. We're one of the area's most popular motels and the owners-operators Stella and Rhett have a wealth of local knowledge to share with you. . All Units Serviced Daily . Free Unlimited WIFI . Heat Pumps / Air Conditioning . Laundry and a Drying Room . Undercover BBQ Area

name: Distinction Hamilton Hotel & Conference Centre
description: Distinction Hamilton Hotel & Conference Centre offers 147 air-conditioned hotel rooms and suites, many of which have been refurbished in 2017. The hotel’s new Superior Rooms & Suites have been designed to feature a modern & contemporary vibe. Guests will be treated to upgraded, luxury beds combined with sumptuous linen ensuring a restful night’s sleep, plush new carpet, increased soundproofing, comfortable armchairs and a work desk, 49” flat screen televisions, free unlimited WiFi and individually controlled heat pumps/air conditioning. Guest services including a gymnasium and bar. The hotel's popular Garnett's Restaurant is open for breakfast and dinner daily. Located only minutes from the Hamilton city centre and conveniently located to reach any out-of-town places of interest, this Hamilton hotel is a favourite with business travellers and holiday makers alike. For families, the proximity of Waterworld is a real bonus and for horse racing enthusiasts, Te Rapa Racecourse is just a short walk away. The Base Hamilton - NZ's largest shopping centre is also just a few minutes walk from our Hamilton hotel. Distinction Hamilton also boasts some of the largest conference facilities in the Waikato area.
address: 100 Garnett Avenue Te Rapa, Hamilton 3241 New Zealand

name: Auto Lodge Motel
description: Come and stay at one of the best motels in Hamilton. Auto Lodge Motel is located only minutes north of central Hamilton, away from the central traffic, easy to find with ample parking. Close to Supermarkets, Cafes, Sky City Casino, Waikato Stadium, Water World, Claudelands Event Centre and the Base Shopping Centre. We offer accommodation to suit all needs; from Studio suites, One-bedroom Suites to Spa Bath Studio Suites. Our Spa Bath Suite, including a luxurious spa, is perfect for a quiet wind-down or a weekend getaway. All units are fully equipped for a comfortable and relaxing stay whatever the occasion. We also offer all the modern day necessities in all our suites including 42 inch Flat Screen Televisions with +50 Sky Digital Channels, Free Unlimited fibre Wifi access, Heat pump and Air-conditioner, large parking area and much more.
address: 298 Ulster Street Whitiora, Hamilton 3200 New Zealand

name: Coromandel Court Motel
description: Welcome to Coromandel Court Motel Excellent location (3-minute stroll to shops and restaurants) Quiet, yet conveniently set in the heart of peaceful Coromandel township opposite bus stop and behind the i-SITE All units ground-floor and designated smoke free Quality accommodation: spacious studio units and 2-brm apartments Quality furnishings throughout Choice of king-size or single beds Groups welcome. Free Wireless internet available. Base yourself in Coromandel Town and explore the many beaches, walkways, history and fishing the region has on offer.25 minute drive to start of the walkway to New Chums Beach rated among the worlds top beaches, an hours drive to Hot Water beach and Cathedral Cove. Hosts: Margaret and Steve

name: Brookby Motel
description: Peaceful bush setting off the main road yet only a 5 minute stroll to the main street for shopping and restaurants. 4 X 1-brm units with full kitchens; 2 x studios with microwave and tea/coffee-making facilities. Guest Select SKY TV offering 50+ channels.

name: Uni Motel
description: We offer 11 contemporary lifestyle room with unbeatable value, all the rooms. All the rooms have a king size bed with super comfortable mattress and all with free WiFi and free parking, complete with separated living, dining and sleeping areas, fully equipped kitchen, daily house - keeping and guest laundry facilities.

name: Paku Lodge
description:
Looking for a place to stay in Tairua? Then look no further than Paku Lodge, a family-friendly motel that brings the best of Tairua to your doorstep.
You’ll enjoy relaxing rooms that offer a refrigerator, a kitchenette, and a sofa, and you can stay connected during your stay as Paku Lodge offers guests free wifi.
For guests with a vehicle, free parking is available.
For those interested in checking out Sailors Grave (2.5 mi) while visiting Tairua, Paku Lodge is a short distance away.
While you’re here, be sure to check out some of the cafes, including The Pepe, Out of the Blue Cafe, and The Old Mill Cafe, all of which are a short distance from Paku Lodge.
There is no shortage of things to do in the area: explore popular art galleries such as The Little Gallery.
We’re sure you’ll enjoy your stay at Paku Lodge as you experience everything Tairua has to offer.
address: 10 The Esplanade Box 63, Tairua 3544 New Zealand

name: Brenton Lodge
description: Brenton Lodge is a boutique lodge with two suites, private balconies and independently accessed both with sea and island views. Set in an acre of garden, with inground pool, and just 2kms from Whangamata town and beach. Just an hour's drive from Cathedral Cove and Hot Water Beach, and minutes from Opoutere. A Continental Breakfast Basket is supplied upon arrival for you to enjoy at your leisure.
address: 2 Brenton Place Rd1, Whangamata 3691 New Zealand

name: Pedlars Motel
description: Welcome to Pedlars Motel – a newly built premium motel situated in the heart of Paeroa. Located right beside the world famous Hauraki Rail Trail, indulge yourself in our immaculate superior accommodation that offers the latest in stylish architectural design and ambience for guests to guarantee their maximum comfort.

name: Atea Lodge
address: 1070 Driving Creek Road, Coromandel 3583 New Zealand

name: Aotearoa Lodge
description: Welcome to Aotearoa Lodge, your ultimate Whitianga retreat. Aotearoa Lodge is dedicated to ensuring your stay is as relaxing and enjoyable as possible, which is why so many guests return year after year. Conveniently located just 1.4 miles from Stu's Wild Pig Farm, Aotearoa Lodge offers easy access to this popular local attraction. Our comfortable rooms feature free WiFi, a TV, a private bathroom, and a refrigerator, allowing you to unwind and stay connected throughout your visit. Guests can also enjoy our sun terrace and 1.5-acre garden. We provide free parking for those travelling with a vehicle. While staying in Whitianga, indulge in delicious burritos at nearby restaurants like The Harbour House Cafe. Don't miss The Lost Spring, a renowned hot spring located just a short distance from Aotearoa Lodge. At Aotearoa Lodge, we bring the best of Whitianga to your fingertips, ensuring your stay is both relaxing and memorable. Book your stay with us today

name: Chevron Motel
description: Here at Chevron Motel, we welcome you with spacious, apartment style units close to the CBD. We are located in central Taupo; 1 block to the town centre, close to cafes, bars, restaurants and cinema. Adjacent to RSA and Cosmopolitan Club. Right at the heart of New Zealand’s most active volcanic zone, Taupo is famous the world over for its trout fishing, but as the saying goes, there’s plenty more fish to catch in this scenic lakeside resort. Stunning scenery, thermal areas wreathed in steam and a host of outdoor pursuits from quad-biking to skydiving make Taupo one of the country’s best-loved holiday destinations Chevron Motel looks forward to welcoming you on your visit to Taupo.

name: Brooklyn Motor Lodge
description: Brooklyn Motor Lodge is a brand new 23-unit motel complex in Hamilton East. We are conveniently located within walking distance to Claudelands Event Centre. Business travellers will appreciate our free internet access all units have heat pumps telephone, alarm clocks, iPod & iPhone docks, kitchens, some units have courtyards.

name: ASURE Prince Motor Lodge
description: Right by the centre of Taupo with an on-site licensed restaurant and Conference Room, ASURE PRINCE offers spacious, air conditioned, single level, courtyard style accommodation - with in-floor (Winter) heating. Park safely by your front door in our courtyard, and you are just a two minute walk from the Town Centre's many shops, Cafes and and over 40 Restaurants. You are also just a 2 minute walk from the shores of our beautiful Lake Taupo - great for an evening stroll before Dinner.. For a lazy evening in, you can take advantage of the Thai Restaurant's free room service, watch a movie on our 50" SMART TV's with 50+ Channels, or surf the web using our unlimited Hi-Speed WiFi service. PRINCE is a great place to SKYPE friends and family from. Away from the busy lakeside traffic, ASURE PRINCE provides 32 generous ground floor units - including 10 with spa baths and separate shower cabinets. All units are serviced daily, and with a mix of NZ Super King, King, Queen, and Single beds PRINCE provides the ideal location for your next Taupo holiday, Sports event, Corporate stop over, or Business Conference. Owner Operators Ron and Mairi and our General Manager Rachel look forward to welcoming you. "We will provide safe, clean, comfortable, and affordable accommodation in a great location - and do all we can to help make your Taupo stay enjoyable".

name: Captain's Quarters Motor Inn
description:
If you’re looking for a family-friendly hotel in Cambridge, look no further than Captain's Quarters Motor Inn.
Rooms at Captain's Quarters Motor Inn provide a refrigerator, a kitchenette, and a desk, and getting online is easy, with free wifi available.
In addition, Captain's Quarters Motor Inn offers a pool, which will help make your Cambridge trip additionally gratifying. And, as an added convenience, there is free parking available to guests.
While in Cambridge, you may want to check out some of the restaurants that are a short walk away from Captain's Quarters Motor Inn, including Kebabelicious (0.4 mi), Lucky Takaways (0.2 mi), and Pony (0.5 mi).
Cambridge is also home to Cambridge Museum, a popular history museum that is not too far from Captain's Quarters Motor Inn.
The staff at Captain's Quarters Motor Inn looks forward to serving you during your upcoming visit.

name: Crows Nest Apartments
description: Crow's Nest Apartments are fully self-contained luxury apartments, ideal for travelling couples, families and groups.Apartments are fully furnished in a modern, contemporary style. Fully equipped kitchens with quality appliances, dishwasher & microwave. Separate bedrooms with queen/twin & single beds. En-suites with bath/shower, hair dryer. Furnished private balconies/patios. Internet facilities, DVD player & 8-channel Sky Digital TV. Washing machine, dryer, iron/ironing board. Roof deck with 360 degree view of Whitianga, outdoor tables & chairs. With the beach only 20 metres away and the main street of Whitianga only a 2 min walk away, our contemporary designed apartments are the ideal choice for an enjoyable and memorable stay in the stunning Mercury Bay of the Coromandel Peninsula. A short stroll to restaurants, shops and ferry. Discover beautiful Cooks Beach, famous Cathedral Cove or dig your own spa at Hot Water Beach.
address: Crows Nest 18-20 Mill Road, Whitianga 3510 New Zealand

name: Tirau Motor Inn
description: Centrally located to Hamilton, Tauranga, and Rotorua, Tirau Motor Inn is also only a short drive from the Lord of the Rings Hobbiton movie set, Okoroire Hot Springs, Blue Springs Walkway, and more! Tirau Motor Inn is situated in a picturesque tourist town with great cafes and shops, and home to the iconic corrugated dog and sheep. It is an older style motel, recently refurbished, owned and run by Kiwis, where old-fashioned customer service is still offered to all our guests.

name: Baycrest Lodge
description: Experience the latest in quality service and surroundings, where traditional elegance blends with a restful ambiance. Baycrest Lodge, Qualmark rated 4 Star Plus is 100m from the main swimming beach of Great Lake Taupo. All 16 units are spacious and elegantly appointed and have tasteful European bathrooms and fully self contained kitchen facilities, including fridges, ceramic hotplates and microwaves. Ground floor suites have individual hot thermal tubs, up to 50'C, 2 of which are full disability access units. First floor suites have large champagne spa baths, balconies and superb Great Lake Taupo views. Super King beds are available in all the studio suites. The 2 room family suites can have either singles or a super king bed as well as the queen bed in the lounge area. Some suites interconnect to make more sleeping configurations. Baycrest Lodge also has a stunning swimming pool thermally heated to between 30'C and 35'C all year round. There is a guest lounge/bar area and a guest laundry on site. Baycrest Lodge is close to a number of restaurants and is about 1 kilometre (flat and easy 15-20 minute walk) from the town centre. It is also in a perfect position to watch many of the major events such as the NZ Ironman. All the suites offer free WiFi (limits apply), Sky's all new 'Guest Select' meaning 50+ channels in every room, 32" LCD TVs with inbuilt DVD player and I-Pod docking. Baycrest Lodge is the ideal place for the discerning traveller, anyone away on business or those just wanting to get away and relax for a time. We look forward to welcoming you to Baycrest Lodge and Taupo.

name: Woodlyn Park
description: We are located in the Waikato, a 2 and a half hour drive south of Auckland and 2 hours across from Rotorua. We are a couple of minutes drive from the world famous Glowworm Caves in Waitomo. Our Motels are world unique, built in part from recycled and natural materials. They have in the past worked hard as a war plane, a navy patrol boat and a carriage from the steam train era. As such they have a slightly lingering aroma from their industrial past, much like any modern vehicle - their scent reflects the materials they are made of. Our Cave Holiday Motel built underground contain natural fibre curtains and some timbers - these too reflect the natural scent of their origins.
address: 1177 Waitomo Valley Road, Waitomo Caves 3977 New Zealand

name: No. 1 Motels
description:
Finding an ideal family-friendly motel in Cambridge does not have to be difficult. Welcome to No. 1 Motels, a nice option for travelers like you.
No. 1 Motels is a family-friendly motel offering a refrigerator and air conditioning in the rooms, and it is easy to stay connected during your stay as free wifi is offered to guests.
The motel features baggage storage. For guests with a vehicle, free parking is available.
While in Cambridge be sure to experience local falafel favorites at Kebabelicious.
If you are interested in exploring Cambridge, check out an art gallery, such as The Garden Art Studio.
No. 1 Motels looks forward to welcoming you on your visit to Cambridge.

name: Te Mata Lodge
description: Located in an idyllic valley, bordered by bush and stream, minutes from the coast. Quality reasonably priced accommodation - cabins, self contained 1 - 2 bedroom cottages and cute chalets. Quiet and peaceful, no road noise. Tranquil swimming river, gold panning, rock/gemstone collecting, bush walks, kayaking, glow worm grotto, MTB/walking track - all free to guests. Function/Games Room and Large covered Kwila deck and BBQ area, Playground, Dining/Kitchen Area, Car/Boat parking, Lodge available larger groups, private events & weddings and exclusive use option. for Friendly owners/managers who are happy to help with trip planning.
address: 18 Eames Crescent Te Mata Bay, Thames Coast, Thames 3575 New Zealand

name: Southpacific Motel & Conference Centre
description: A small family run motel, under new management since October 2023, close to the beach and town centre, set amongst subtropical gardens. Offering cute ground level studio units with great outdoor areas, or one-bedroom apartments available in our 'Hawaii 5-0 block' with air-conditioning. There is a BBQ area available for your use, with covered seating under the tiki umbrellas and a spa pool (hot tub) to relax in after a day at the beach!

name: Waitahanui Lodge
description: The Waitahanui Lodge is all about the kiwi bach experience. The original lodge was built in 1932 as a fishing lodge that by today's standards would have been fairly basic. In the 1950's a new lodge was built right by the lake's edge and close to the world renowned Waitahanui River. With renovations and upgrading the Lodge has up to date facilities and caters for today's travellers, yet the "kiwiana soul" of the Lodge remains. The lodge consists of 5 well equipped, self catering cottages, accommodating up to 5 guests. All linen is supplied. Absolute lakefront location can be enjoyed from two of our cottages while the others are just a few steps away. Our wonderful lakeside terrace provides the perfect spot for a barbecue or simply to enjoy a great sunset. Our on site tackle shop has waders and rods for hire plus all the fishing tackle needed to fish our local rivers for trout.
address: 116 State Highway 1 Waitahanui, Taupo 3378 New Zealand

name: Waitomo Boutique Lodge
description: Waitomo Boutique Lodge Farmstay is Waitomo's hidden gem, offering a five star farm holiday stay in a stunning setting, close to all the central North Island's major attractions including Hobbiton movie set - and a stone's throw from the action of Waitomo Caves. Choose from the cosy garden Cottage or the Boutique country homestead, which is available as an exclusive luxury lodge experience with a spectacular view.
address: 256 Waipuna Road Waitomo, Te Kuiti 3985 New Zealand
rank_string: #3 of 6 Speciality lodging in Te Kuiti

name: Belle Vue Boutique Lodge
description: Belle vue Boutique Lodge is a magnificent English / French Provincial Style Lodge, overlooking the magnificent Lake Taupo and Mount Tauhara, surrounded by picturesque gardens and all the extra amenities and facilities every traveller could require. Exquisite Guest Lounge and Guest Dining Room, with Evening Fine Dining available. Liz and Steve are dedicated to ensure your stay is never forgotten and you cannot wait to plan your next stay. Just 3.4 kms to Town and Oh So Quiet and Peaceful.
address: 39 Mapara Road, Acacia Bay, Taupo 3385 New Zealand
rank_string: #1 of 1 B&Bs / Inns in Acacia Bay

name: Kinloch Manor & Villas
description: ‘Perfectly placed on a 254ha spectacular setting above the shores of Lake Taupo, heart of the internationally recognized adventure and wilderness playground is the new uber-luxury lodge Kinloch Manor & Villas. Opened in 2017 and featuring New Zealand’s only Jack Nicklaus Signature 18-hole Links Golf Course, voted #1 course in New Zealand by PGA professionals. The Lodge’s wild adventure concierge offering includes New Zealand’s most popular day hike, the Tongariro Alpine Crossing plus world class fly-fishing, white water rafting, forest and lake cycling are as spectacular as the Lodge welcoming whiskey and champagne bar, cuisine featuring ‘Farm to Table’ organics - 100% pesticide free with produce from the owners private estate. And the township of Kinloch’s spectacular lake frontage provides almost 3km of sandy beach, ideal for swimming in the stunning blue fresh water or strolling along the water’s edge. With interiors by multi-award winning designer Virginia Fisher, renowned for her work involving luxury lodges in New Zealand, the lodge and Manor Suites, 1 and 2 bedroom Luxury Residences with an additional Den, making a third bedroon or TV room - all feature stunning designer elements including vista windows of the lake and golf course, huge log fireplaces, sensational marble bathrooms and secluded furnished terraces.
address: 261 Kinloch Road Taupo, Kinloch 3377 New Zealand

name: Matamata Central Motel
description: We extend a warm welcome to visitors to the Matamata area. Matamata Central Motel is your ideal accommodation provider for overnight stays while travelling through south, north, west or east, or for staying in Matamata for the Hobbit experience or visiting the equine facilities. We can provide accommodation: fully serviced, self-contained units. Matamata Central Motel was opened in 2010 and is the newest Motel in Matamata. The motel has a drive through entrance and all units open on to the court yard. Lawns and covered area for smoking. Car parking beside your unit. All units are double glazed with 32in flat screen tvs.
address: 42 Waharoa Road West, Matamata 3400 New Zealand

name: Chalet Eiger
description: Chalet Eiger offers luxury accommodation in a tranquil environment with lake and mountain views. Chalet Eiger’s location makes it perfectly situated for easy access to the many activities in the surrounding area. The Kiwi-influenced cuisine utilizes home grown and locally sourced produce with an excellent selection of New Zealand wines.
address: 534 Gillespie Place Acacia Bay, Taupo 3385 New Zealand

name: Tuakau Hotel
description: Enjoy the warm ambience of our boutique country hotel 40 mins south of Auckland Airport at the Gateway to Waikato with 10 hotel rooms and 7 self-contained apartments. Each room is well appointed with a luxurious king-size bed, individual climate control, sound insulation, internet access, SKY TV, and complimentary refreshments, while the licensed restaurant, lounge and sports bars, TAB and gaming room, and conference facilities cater for all your entertainment needs. 7 Mins south of Pukekohe means convenient access to Pukekohe Race Track and Counties Manukau Rugby. Just 15 mins to the internationally acclaimed Hampton Downs MotorSport Race Track. Centrally located to provide easy access to both the wild West Coast beaches for surfing and the protected waters of the Hauraki Gulf for boating. Enjoy bush walking in the Hunua Ranges, a hot spa at Miranda, or the cycle trails on the Hauraki Plains.

name: Little Haven
description: Little Haven Taupo offers a welcoming mix of one, two, and three-bedroom units, perfect for couples, families, business travelers, and small groups visiting the area. Our ongoing refurbishments ensure each unit is fresh, modern, and fully self-contained, while our central location keeps you just moments from Taupo’s town center and stunning lakefront. Guests can enjoy a range of complimentary on-site facilities designed for comfort and relaxation — soak in the spa pool, take a swim in the outdoor pool, or let the kids explore the playground. Surrounded by beautiful park-like grounds, Little Haven offers the ideal setting for a relaxing stay in family-run accommodation right in the heart of Taupo.
address: 52 Rifle Range Road, Taupo, Taupo 3330 New Zealand

name: The Olive Rabbit - Boutique Bed & Breakfast
description: The sought-after Tongariro River is in the heart of the Central Volcanic Plateau of New Zealand. This stunning location takes peoples' breath away, providing the perfect setting for an unforgettable, magical holiday in Nature. The Olive Rabbit is a luxurious bed and breakfast in the quiet, riverside location of Turangi. Since we cater more for grown-ups, you can be assured of peace and tranquillity with the local birdlife being the only sounds to serenade your stay. When you stop with us, you'll enjoy a guest experience service second to none. Our rooms are extremely comfortable, our welcoming spa is wonderfully relaxing, our drinks and canapes, and our delicious breakfasts are mouth-watering and satisfying. Whether you are looking for an action-packed breakaway or somewhere to just escape and re-charge your batteries, The Olive Rabbit is your perfect paradise! ​ ​

name: Great Lake Motel Taupo
description: 15 self-contained motel units, studio and one bedroom, situated only a couple of minutes walk from the town centre. There are also 2 bedroom / 2 bathroom lakefront apartments. Some units have large spa baths, all units have a kitchen with microwave, hotplates, fridge and kitchen utensils. Sky TV is available as well as Freeview channels. We are across the road from lovely Lake Taupo with views to the mountains, but only the apartments get uninterrupted views.
address: 56 Lake Terrace PO Box 221, Taupo 3330 New Zealand

name: Rose Lodge Bed & Breakfast
description: Rose Lodge Bed and Breakfast in Tirau is a great base for visiting the Central North Island being 40 minutes to Rotorua, 44 minutes to Tauranga, 40 minutes to Hamilton, and 1 hour to Taupo. We are just 10 minutes, 12km from The Blue Springs, 19 minutes, 22km away from the Hobbiton Movie Set and 11 minutes, 14km from The Red Barn Wedding Venue. Quiet and relaxing Rose Lodge is central to wonderful walks, cycling tracks, river trails, 3 golf courses and more. Set within a Grand Villa are two beautifully appointed rooms with a queen bed and private bathroom, with original features of a bygone era. A breakfast of fresh fruit, fresh pastries, cereal, yoghurt and fresh juice serves for a good start to the day. Enjoy relaxing in the garden or take a walk into town and enjoy some fantastic shopping and have lunch in one of the many fabulous cafes. Whether you're here for a romantic retreat, a weekend escape, or a relaxing stop on your journey. Rose Lodge is the perfect place to unwind.

name: Finlay Jack's Backpackers
description:
Taupo's best option for comfort, convenience and great times with international friends. 

Here you'll find a bunk-free experience with single beds made up ready for your arrival and delightful en-suite bathrooms. We've renovated one of Taupo's most central hostels with the modern backpacker in mind. 

Two minutes from the supermarkets and central bus station, we have a comfy DVD lounge, huge garden, massive balcony complete with BBQ and stunning views of Mt. Ngauruhoe (Mt. Doom) and beyond. 

Whether you're an adrenaline junky keen to launch yourself from a plane at 15,000 feet, looking to set sail on the Great Lake or seeking peace and tranquillity along with some of New Zealand's most beautiful walks, our staff are here to make sure your visit lives up to expectations...aim high, people!

name: Coromandel Apartments
description: Welcome to Coromandel Apartments. At Coromandel Apartments we want guests to share and enjoy the beautiful and historic Coromandel Township and explore nearby attractions unique to the Coromandel Peninsula. We have been welcoming and accommodating both domestic and international visitors for many years. Coromandel Apartments has 7 apartments available for guests to book. Each apartment is individually furnished and situated in 4 different locations – with 4 apartments conveniently located in the township and 3 apartments located nearby at Coromandel Harbour’s edge and Wyuna Bay (only a short drive from the centre of town). All apartments provide WIFI, kitchen facilities, free parking and are professionally cleaned by a dedicated team of housekeepers. Thank you for choosing to stay with Coromandel Apartments. We wish you a comfortable stay in our managed apartments and exploring the unique and beautiful area of Coromandel. Hamish & Jeanette – Coromandel Apartments

name: Goldmine Motel Waihi
description: We are a friendly, family-owned motel situated in a lovely quiet location in historical Waihi. Our 10 spacious and comfortable units are ideal for corporate stays, weekend getaways or longer stays for those who want to explore the diverse local area. Our motel is a short walk to Waihi’s town centre which has many lovely cafés and restaurants to choose from as well as a great range of locally owned stores and boutiques where you can browse and shop. Because of our location right at the base of the glorious Coromandel Peninsula, day trips from here are easily possible and Waihi Beach is only a 15 minute car ride away. There is so much to see and do. We offer free unlimited fibre WIFI, with connected Smart TVs allowing you to sign in to your favourite streaming platforms such as Netflix or Lightbox. Take a break and visit us here at the Goldmine Motel. We would love to see you.

name: Podium Lodge
description: Podium Lodge is a newly built, modern, 86 bed facility offering a unique experience in a vibrant yet peaceful setting that inspires excellence with large interactive communal areas. Designed to support athletes with their training or performance ambitions but we welcome anyone looking for a quiet yet vibrant and inspiring getaway. Podium Lodge is a home away from home, its the place you come back to after a busy day of work, activity or competition. Our quality appointed studios, two bedroom apartments and 14 bed dormitory are comfortable, functional and offer large rooms equipped with, hot showers, space to cook, eat, relax and interact. Gear storage facilities, equipment wash down space, bike racks and a bike maintenance station are yours to use when you stay. Podium Lodge is a charitable enterprise whose priority is its purpose, not its profit, with 100% of proceeds being returned to community.

name: Lake Karapiro Lodge
description: 5 star Lake Karapiro Lodge is the ultimate in luxury accommodation. Enjoy one of your best sleeps ever and wake to a unique environment with stunning views over Lake Karapiro, the mighty Waikato River and lush Waikato countryside. Located in the centre of the North Island Karapiro has something for everyone... boating, water skiing, bush walks and a great choice of golf courses with sandy beaches, snow fields and lots of other adventures all nearby. Famous for the silver service full daily breakfast included in the room rate. Enjoy the Salt Water Pool, the Spa pool and Sauna (pool use is seasonal) Lake Karapiro Lodge," in the middle of nowhere but is centre of everything".

name: Tuscany on Thames
description: A four star property we pride ourselves in our attention to detail and modern decor. All units ) have double spa baths (except access), kitchen facilities, internet and SKY TV with 50+ guest select. The property also has a swimming pool and guest laundry. Ideally located a one minute drive from the beginning of the main street of Thames which is the service centre for the beautiful Coromandel Penninsular

name: The Olive Motel
description: We are a small motel 250 meters from the centre of Coromandel Town. Coromandel Town is 2.5 hours from Auckland city. All our rooms have air conditioning and free fast wifi. We offer 3 x 50 square meter 1 bedroom suites that can sleep up to 5 (built 2007). 6 x 25 square meter studio with queen beds that can sleep up to 3 (built in 2015 and 2019) . 1 x 68 square meter 2 bedroom suite that can sleep up to 6 ( built in 2015). All our suites have spa baths and large bathrooms and Freeview TV ,Netflix and Prime video our studios have ensuite shower rooms .

name: Tidewater Motel & Tourist Park
description: Tidewater Tourist Park is set in parklike grounds of an historic villa right in the heart of Coromandel town, on the Coromandel peninsula. From our spacious grounds you can take in the gorgeous views of the Coromandel Harbour and the magnificent sunrises and sunsets. A photographers dream. The hostel is only 200 metres to the main street of town and many fine restaurants, bars and cafes. Enjoy our beautiful grounds, BBQ area or indulge in a private sauna.

name: Underhill Valley Earth Huts
description: Underhill Valley is part of Canopy Camping Escapes' growing network of New Zealand glamping sites. Built into the hillside, this remarkable cave-style house has been beautifully handcrafted with rustic native timbers and ironwork, to create a sustainable and authentic space. Underhill Valley makes a perfect romantic retreat for couples.

name: Maple Lodge Motel
description:
If you’re looking for a family-friendly motel in Matamata, look no further than Maple Lodge Motel.
The rooms offer a flat screen TV, a kitchenette, and a refrigerator, and getting online is possible, as free wifi is available, allowing you to rest and refresh with ease.
Maple Lodge Motel features baggage storage. In addition, as a valued Maple Lodge Motel guest, you can enjoy a pool and barbeque facilities that are available on-site. Guests arriving by vehicle have access to free parking.
Travelers looking to enjoy some shrimp can head to Osteria Matamata. Otherwise, you may want to check out a cafe such as Workmans Cafe Bar, Eat Cafe, or O-Del-Emz.
The staff at Maple Lodge Motel looks forward to serving you during your upcoming visit.

name: Walnut Lodge Bed & Breakfast
description: Located at the end of a private lane, less than 5 mins drive from Matamata Township situated on 1.4 hectares. Walnut lodge is your ideal bed and breakfast choice; enjoy the rural setting with views to Kaimai ranges and rolling countryside with beautiful sunsets. You will get a real sense of sereneness and relaxation. Each individual studio has its own bathroom, kitchenette, separate spacious living room and dining, contemporary in design with all the modern comforts one would expect. The kitchen includes a fridge, convection microwave, toaster and tea/coffee facilities. Complimentary continental breakfast provisions are included with a selection of cereals, yoghurt, jams, fresh bread, juice, teas and freshly ground coffee. Delivered in the evening so you can enjoy at your leisure in the morning. *Gluten Free breakfast available - request on booking
address: 29 Aporo Drive, RD2, Matamata 3472 New Zealand

name: Coromandel Seaview Motel
description:
Coromandel Seaview Motel
Perfectly positioned between the mountains and the sea, Coromandel Seaview Motel offers a peaceful escape with stunning views across Long Bay and McGregor Bay. We invite you to come and spend a night or two with us and share what this wonderful place has to offer. All of our three rooms enjoy their own private decks, the stunning views of the village, the ocean and islands beyond. Guests enjoy breakfast on the deck in the mornings and after a busy day of adventure you can now relax and enjoy the views in our open air spa. Hahei is on the Coromandel Peninsula on the east coast of North Island, New Zealand. It’s a stunning piece of coastline that provides a mecca for New Zealand holiday makers and overseas visitors alike. The outlook is superb and there are countless things to do and see whether you are budding adventurers or just want to relax and unwind. Hahei is the gateway to world renowned Cathedral Cove. 5 minutes drive sees you at Hot Water Beach and close by the many other beautiful Mercury Bay attractions. The rest of the Peninsula lays in wait not much further a field. See you soon!

The quaint seaside village of Raglan on the west coast offers surfers the challenge of a left-hand surf break and is only 40 minutes drive from Shailers. Shailers is also 10 minutes drive to Vilagrad Winery, 15 minutes to the Mystery Creek event centre, 60 minutes to Hobbiton and less than 90 minutes to the thermal capital of the world, Rotorua.

The 3 bedroom homestead is very cosy, with a coal range in the dining room and a fire place in the lounge. Fully functional kitchen plus a BBQ. Mobile reception for Spark and vodafone. Also available on the property for extended family is a one bedroom cottage. The river is on the boundary good trout fishing and a great swimming hole nearby. Quite an array of exotic animals. DOC bush walks to the Pinnacles further up the valley. History tour of the old buildings, horse ride for children and llama treks are available on request. Access to the property is via a ford river crossing, in the event of heavy rain there will be no vehicle access. On these occasions there is a swingbridge access across the river and you will be met by a tractor to transport you and your bags to the house.
